title: Initial matrix
changes: Launch the four-quadrant task board with browser-local persistence, categories, due dates and notes.
Include task editing, completion, search, backups, appearance controls and the original focus timer.

title: Projects
changes: Add project creation, renaming, task assignment and project filtering.
Extend persistence, validation and backups to include projects.

title: Adjustable text size
changes: Add persistent text-size controls from 90% to 160%.
Adapt typography and responsive layouts to the chosen size.

title: Quadrant add controls and responsive filters
changes: Move quadrant add controls to the lower-right corner.
Rework filter rows and give dropdown chevrons consistent spacing.

title: Clearspace favicon
changes: Add the Clearspace SVG favicon and reference it from the page.

title: Floating quadrant buttons
changes: Refine the round quadrant FABs, their positioning and card spacing.

title: Seven-step onboarding
changes: Add the first-visit tutorial with Back, Next and Skip controls.
Allow the walkthrough to be replayed through Help.

title: Task and project add menu
changes: Combine task and project creation in an Add menu.

title: Project form ordering correction
changes: Correct the ordering of the project picker in the task editor.

title: Example tasks at the end of onboarding
changes: Make Start with example tasks the final tutorial action.
Keep example creation deduplicated and offer an own-tasks alternative.

title: Branding, progress cards and custom focus duration
changes: Enlarge the brand and place its tagline underneath.
Split progress into compact statistic cards and allow custom timer durations.
Add the P shortcut for project management.

title: Custom quadrant icons
changes: Add a generic icon picker beside editable quadrant titles.
Enlarge quadrant count badges.

title: Settings menu and compact statistics
changes: Move appearance, labels and Help controls into Settings.
Enlarge the date, tighten Add, capitalize statistic labels and center their numbers.

title: Minimal hero copy
changes: Reduce the hero to a shorter Your matrix heading and less supporting text.

title: Focus countdown in the header
changes: Close the timer dialog when a focus session starts.
Display remaining time in the header Focus control.

title: Settings icon and text-size placement
changes: Add an icon to Edit labels and move text-size controls lower in Settings.

title: Inline timer editing
changes: Allow double-clicking the clock to edit minutes or MM:SS.
Retain session presets, validation and keyboard save/cancel controls.

title: Fixed branding and timer backdrop dismissal
changes: Keep marketing title/subtitle fixed while preserving quadrant customization.
Allow clicking outside the timer dialog to close it.

title: Illustrated empty states
changes: Use urgency and importance descriptions as quadrant subtitles.
Add custom SVG illustrations to the four empty states.

title: Board reset and restored marketing header
changes: Restore Make room for what matters. and its subtitle.
Add a confirmed task reset with Undo. At this historical version, projects were retained.

title: Interface design refresh
changes: Refresh system typography, rounded surfaces, responsive layouts and theme styling.
Respect reduced motion, transparency and contrast preferences.

title: Ten-second notifications
changes: Auto-dismiss notifications, including Undo notifications, after ten seconds.

title: Owner-authorized Dev tools
changes: Add the historical owner-authorized Dev sample generator and server authorization routes.
Introduce Worker packaging and development-tool regression checks. These hosted Dev routes were removed in later releases.

title: React and TypeScript migration
changes: Replace the main app with React 19, strict TypeScript, Vite and Zod-validated domain state.
Organize task, project, settings, tutorial and backup features into components and hooks.
Add Vitest, React Testing Library, Worker tests and typed persistence while retaining existing browser data.

title: Theme toggle and progress redesign
changes: Repair the settings icon and move light/dark switching into a header toggle.
Redesign progress into a compact completion ring and task counts.

title: Task notes and complete board reset
changes: Show task notes directly on cards.
Reset both tasks and projects, explain the scope in confirmation, and preserve Undo.

title: Local Dev tools, motion, mobile polish and CI
changes: Restrict Dev samples to local development and remove hosted Dev routes and the standalone variant.
Add Heroicons, custom Base UI selects, drag feedback, quadrant-clear celebrations and softer transitions.
Improve mobile input/viewport behavior, sticky axes, sorting and typography.
Add ownership guidance, a PR template, pre-commit hooks and pinned CI checks for code, dependencies and secrets.

title: Browser regression coverage and board UX
changes: Add the Playwright desktop/mobile regression suite and improve cross-tab updates.
Introduce the unified Filters panel, applied-filter chips, tab counts and empty-board starter card.
Improve the header illustration, green accents, mobile controls and production caching/security checks.

title: Confirmed fresh start and mobile hero
changes: Require typing Reset before clearing tasks and projects.
Synchronize theme application before paint and remove shortcut hints from Settings.
Hide marketing text on mobile and refine the illustrated header and project form spacing.

title: Subtasks, US dates and modal paint fixes
changes: Add editable subtasks, card checklists, backup/search compatibility and independent completion.
Display due dates as MM/DD/YYYY while retaining ISO storage.
Randomize subtasks in local Dev samples, improve modal opening/backdrop behavior, and enlarge hero artwork.
Consolidate desktop toolbar actions and compact search/filter controls.

title: Hero progress and onboarding hierarchy
changes: Move progress beneath the hero subtitle with a narrow-column stacked layout.
Enlarge quadrant icons and tighten title/subtitle spacing.
Give Getting Started a larger heading, an accessible progress bar, top-positioned Skip and bottom Back/Next navigation.

title: Matrix-first day panel
changes: Put the matrix first, with a day rail on wide screens and a compact day bar elsewhere.
Add and link the contributor overview with architecture and delivery flowcharts.

title: Guided first-task creation
changes: Remove the duplicate toolbar Add task button while retaining Projects and the N shortcut.
Hide quadrant and mobile FABs until the board contains tasks; reveal them with reduced-motion-aware animation.
Restore the starter experience after clearing all tasks without treating filtered-empty views as empty boards.
Fix the animated onboarding browser test to wait for dialog DOM removal before reopening.

title: Adaptive board layout and refreshed documentation
changes: Fold the wide-screen day rail into a day bar when a quadrant has more than four tasks in the selected status tab. Search, category, and project filters do not change this layout decision.
Add the tracked release timeline, source mapping, and README links.
Refresh the architecture, deployment, and contributor overview for current task controls, data flow, local Dev tools, and CI.

title: First-task prompt in the day panel
changes: Move the first-task prompt into the day panel on an empty board, keeping the starter actions together with the day information.
Update responsive styling, README guidance, and browser assertions for the empty-board layout.

title: GitHub link in the header
changes: Add a GitHub repository link to the header with responsive styling and component test coverage.

title: Clearer project creation and deletion
changes: Disable project creation until the trimmed name has at least two characters, including keyboard submission, and clear stale duplicate-name feedback while editing.
Use a simple named confirmation for deleting empty projects while preserving task counts and warnings for populated projects.
Update component and desktop/mobile browser assertions for the revised project flows.

title: Project rename controls and adaptive rail layout
changes: Enable project Save only when the trimmed draft differs from the saved name; disable it after a successful rename or when edits are reverted.
Clear stale rename validation feedback when editing, with component and desktop/mobile browser coverage.
Include the latest main layout change that folds the side rail when tall quadrants hide the bottom row.
